title: Mary P NDE 3051
content: I was in a small hospital away from my parents and very concerned for myself. They could not take me to surgery and I have a rare blood type that they did not have on hand. It seemed like when I would pass I was in the most beautiful place with green, a river, and all these people were so glad to see me. I did not know anyone who had died in my family at that time. The person that said he was waiting on me was wearing a straw hat, bib overalls with a white handkerchief in the pocket and had the most amazing blue eyes. Also, other people there were helping me. It was so peaceful there that I could have stayed very easily but I was begging them that I had a husband and a little boy to take care of and I couldn't stay. He said okay but not sure, your body can hold you. I would wake up in the hospital bed convulsing, I would slip back to the same place with the peaceful people, and we would go through the same thing. Not sure how many times I went back and forth but the last time I heard the nurses say there is no pulse and no heartbeat, we need to call her husband. I was immediately able to talk and said please don't call my husband he has to go to work this morning. They looked like I had shot them and said I had really given them a scare. For five years, I couldn't talk to anyone about this but had such a feeling of peace about life and death I know now that it is a choice and we are here for certain reasons. Two years ago my brother blew up a 1920's picture of my Grandma and Grandpa on horseback, he died when my mother was only twelve years old, and he was the man helping me on the other side.

arrival.other_being_detail: A man 'waiting on me' wearing a straw hat, bib overalls with a white handkerchief in the pocket, and with 'the most amazing blue eyes.' Later identified as her grandfather who died when her mother was twelve.

environment.environment_other_detail: Described as 'the most beautiful place with green, a river.'

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Repeatedly 'slip back to the same place' and then wake 'in the hospital bed convulsing' (back-and-forth multiple times). Final return coincided with hearing nurses say there was 'no pulse and no heartbeat.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: In a small hospital needing surgery; staff lacked her rare blood type. She later heard nurses say 'there is no pulse and no heartbeat.'

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Repeated back-and-forth between the hospital bed (including convulsing) and the peaceful place; she heard nurses saying there was 'no pulse and no heartbeat.'
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Rather than a single progression, she repeatedly 'would wake up in the hospital bed convulsing' and then 'slip back to the same place' multiple times.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Repeated returns to the same peaceful place and back to the hospital bed.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Repeated cycling between the hospital bed (convulsing) and the same peaceful place; she later recognized the helper as her grandfather from an enlarged 1920s photo.
unique_elements.notable_quotes:
“It seemed like when I would pass I was in the most beautiful place with green, a river, and all these people were so glad to see me.”
“He said okay but not sure, your body can hold you.”
“...the nurses say there is no pulse and no heartbeat, we need to call her husband.”
“For five years, I couldn't talk to anyone about this but had such a feeling of peace about life and death...”
